question: Rangaswami Cup is associated with sports _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hockey**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Rangaswami Cup** is associated with the sport of **Hockey**.
 
• It is one of the prestigious tournaments in Indian hockey, contributing to the development and recognition of the sport in the country.
